newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar quiet in PM on NY holiday.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar quiet in PM on NY holiday.

text.p: London sugar futures stayed quiet on Friday afternoon, because of the New York market's holiday.
By 1510 GMT, 400 lots had traded, with business dominated by August on 325 lots.
It last changed hands 60 cents lower at $319.30.
But August volume was much inflated by one big AA trade, one trader said. "There's no interest at all," he said.
The New York raw sugar market is closed because because of the July 4 Independence Day holiday.
